title: Signing Lead After the Measure — Ridgeline Installation Services Permit Handling
content:
How soon a Ridgeline Installation Services customer signed after the measure sets the signing-lead share of the permit handling fee.

**Clause.** Signing-lead share of the permit handling fee: the signing lead is the calendar days from the measure completion date to the contract signing date; a signing lead of at most the quick-signing days of 7 takes the quick-signing share of 0.9, a signing lead of more than the late-signing days of 21 takes the late-signing multiple of 1.1, and any other signing lead takes a signing-lead share of 1.

The permit handling fee is multiplied by the signing-lead share; neither the share nor any amount formed on the way to the permit handling fee is rounded, the permit handling fee being rounded to the cent only at the end.

Both dates are read from the contract record: the date the measure was completed and the date the agreement was signed.

| Signing lead | Signing-lead share |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 days | 0.9 |
| 8 to 21 days | 1 |
| 22 days or more | 1.1 |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical measure completed 5 August)

| Agreement signed | Signing lead | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 12 August | 7 | 0.9 |
| 13 August | 8 | 1 |
| 26 August | 21 | 1 |
| 27 August | 22 | 1.1 |

**Hypothetical:** a handling fee of 75.00 before the share becomes 67.50 on a signing lead of 3 days and 82.50 on a signing lead of 40 days.
